meta.title: Terms of Service
meta.description: Terms of use for the VireMusic platform

general.title: General Provisions
paragraphs: These Terms govern the use of the VireMusic platform (the “Service”), built for publishing and streaming independent music by artists from the CIS.
By using the Service, you accept these Terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the Service.

contentRights.title: Content Rights
paragraphs: An artist who publishes tracks and releases on VireMusic retains all exclusive rights to their work.

By uploading content, the artist grants VireMusic a royalty-free, non-exclusive license to reproduce, transmit, and display that content as part of operating the Service (streaming for registered users, display of metadata and cover art).
VireMusic does not claim ownership of, or co-authorship in, artists' content.

ugc.title: Publishing Rules (User-Generated Content)
ugc.intro: By publishing content on the platform, the user guarantees that:
items: they hold all rights necessary for the content being published;
the content does not infringe the copyright of third parties;
the content does not contain material prohibited under applicable law;
the content is not spam, fraud, or misleading material.
ugc.outro: VireMusic reserves the right to remove content that violates these rules, or to suspend account access, without prior notice.

account.title: User Account
paragraphs: Access to some features requires an account — created via Yandex (OAuth) or by email (password or magic link).
You are responsible for keeping access to your account secure and for all actions taken under your account.
To protect against password guessing, the Service limits the number of login attempts from a single IP address per unit of time.

streaming.title: Streaming and Downloads
paragraphs: Registered users can stream published tracks via HLS streaming.
Downloading tracks in FLAC format is available only after purchase from the artist (this feature is under development and is not currently offered on public pages).
Extracting, copying, or distributing audio material outside the Service without the rights holder's permission is prohibited.

presave.title: Release Presave
paragraphs: For announced releases, a presave is available — you mark your intent to listen to the release before it comes out. Registered users only need to click the button; guests must provide an email address.
On the release day, it is automatically added to your likes, and a notification is sent to the email address you provided.

playlists.title: Playlists and Likes
paragraphs: Registered users can create playlists, add tracks to them, and like tracks and playlists (including public playlists created by other users). A playlist can be private or accessible via a link.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
paragraphs: The Service is provided “as is.” VireMusic makes no guarantee of uninterrupted operation and is not liable for any indirect damages arising from use of the Service.

changes.title: Changes to These Terms
paragraphs: VireMusic reserves the right to amend these Terms. We will notify users of material changes. Continued use of the Service after such changes constitutes acceptance of them.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How VireMusic handles users' personal data

dataCollected.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollected.oauthIntro: When you sign up via Yandex (OAuth), we receive:
oauthItems: your avatar URL (we store the link; the image itself is not copied).
dataCollected.emailAuth: When you sign up by email (password or magic link), we receive only your email address.
dataCollected.ownAvatar: If you upload your own avatar, the image is stored in our file storage (S3).
dataCollected.presaveGuest: When you presave an announced release without signing in, we receive only the email address you provide for the release notification.
dataCollected.usageIntro: As you use the Service, we record:
usageItems: the playlists you create and their contents;
release presaves: user_id for registered users, or email for guests;
play events: track_id, an anonymous session_id, date/time, duration, and playback source. A user_id is attached only for registered users;
favorite moments on a track (timestamp + anonymous session_id; user_id only for registered users);
the “listening now” presence signal — an anonymous session_id kept in in-memory storage (Redis), never retained longer than 45 seconds of inactivity;
mood tags and genres assigned to a track (by the track's owning artist only).

dataUse.title: How We Use the Data
items: Authenticating and identifying you within the Service.
A taste profile for the track-recommendation algorithm (“Wave”) — aggregated from your listening and like history (track mood tags and genres) to generate personal recommendations.
Notifying you about a release you've presaved, and automatically adding the release to your likes on release day.
Analytics for artists: play counts, unique listeners, day-by-day trends.
Ensuring security and preventing abuse (including rate-limiting requests by IP address).

dataSharing.title: Sharing Data with Third Parties
dataSharing.intro: We do not sell or share personal data with third parties for advertising or commercial purposes.
items: with infrastructure providers (hosting, file storage, email delivery) — to the extent necessary to operate the Service;
at the request of authorized government bodies, in cases established by law.

cookies.title: Cookies, Browser Storage, and Analytics
cookies.necessary: We use essential cookies — an Auth.js session token for user authentication.
cookies.metricaIntro: To collect site traffic statistics, the platform uses Yandex.Metrica (JSC “Yandex”, Russia). Metrica collects:
metricaItems: data on pages viewed, referral sources, and time spent on the site;
session recordings — Webvisor (mouse movement, clicks, scrolling). Webvisor does not capture input into form fields (passwords, emails).
cookies.metricaPolicy: This data is processed by Yandex in accordance with <link>Yandex's privacy policy</link>. We do not share personal data (email, name) with Yandex — only browser session behavioral data.
cookies.localStorage: localStorage is used to store player state (playback queue, volume, track position) and interface preferences (for example, whether you've dismissed a banner). This data stays in your browser and is never sent to our server.

storage.title: Data Storage and Deletion
storage.location: Data is stored on servers in Russia (Timeweb Cloud VPS). Files — cover art, audio files, avatars — are stored in S3-compatible storage on the same infrastructure.
storage.deletion: To delete your account and the personal data associated with it, use the <link>feedback form</link>. We will process your request within 14 days.
storage.afterDeletion: After account deletion, anonymized play events (without a user_id) may be retained in aggregated statistics.

security.title: Security
paragraphs: We apply standard technical safeguards: HTTPS, an httpOnly session cookie, and files stored in a private S3 bucket accessible only via signed URLs.

policyChanges.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We will notify users of material changes to this Privacy Policy by email or via an in-Service notification.
